names.name: --ds-ease
names.note: Same value (the linear() path where supported). MOTION_FALLBACKS['--ds-ease'] is gone too.

names.name: --ds-spinner-sm-track
names.note: It had no effect since 1.0: delete it from the theme.

names.name: --ds-state-pulse
names.note: Read only by ds-pulse; a placeholder is a .ds-skeleton (ds-skeleton-wave).

names.name: --ds-loop-pulse
names.note: A placeholder is a .ds-skeleton, whose wave runs on --ds-loop-skeleton.

names.name: ds-pulse
names.note: One wave across the bones (ds-skeleton-wave); an animation that names ds-pulse plays nothing.

names.name: ds-indeterminate
names.note: Or .ds-loadbar: both run ds-progress-head and ds-progress-tail on --ds-loop-indeterminate.

names.name: ds-sink-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--sink, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'sink').

names.name: ds-scale-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--scale, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'scale').

names.name: ds-slide-out
names.note: Two animation entries, or .ds-leave--slide, or DS.motion.leave(el, 'slide').

names.name: DS.motion.easeOutCubic
names.note: Remove every call and import: an import of it from js/motion.js stops the module from loading. countUp() runs on --ds-ease-value.

names.name: .ds-btn__swap
names.note: .ds-btn__faces with .ds-btn__face, .ds-btn__face--busy and .ds-btn__face--done, driven by DS.motion.busy().

names.name: data-open on .ds-combo
names.note: DS.overlay.open(list, { opener: field }) sets aria-expanded on the field, which turns the chevron.

names.name: the live region .ds-toasts[role] / .ds-toasts[aria-live]
names.note: DS.overlay.toast() announces through its own two announcers and strips role and aria-live from an old region on first use; never role="alert" on a message.

names.name: the hand recipe that moves snackbars into a side sheet
names.note: A page no longer sets --ds-toast-shift or --ds-toast-shift-y, nor closes snackbars with setTimeout: DS.overlay moves the region into an open sheet and glides the messages (both properties stay, written by DS.overlay only), and toast() times them.

names.name: the hand data-scrolled recipe
names.note: The 1.x App frame recipe: a page's own IntersectionObserver on a sentinel writes data-scrolled. Delete the observer, the sentinel and the page's own watchScrolled function, and call DS.dom.watchScrolled(view) once; DS.overlay.open() watches sheet and dialog bodies itself.

names.name: .ds-view--leaving
names.note: With it goes the manual swap recipe (settled() on the content, then enter(newContent, 'swap')).

names.name: settleLoader(startedAt, now)
names.note: A number as the second argument; the pattern finds a literal, a variable named now and the two clocks.

names.name: ds-fill-x
names.note: A mark scaled to its share squashes its round end; --ds-share clips it. Use .ds-enter--fill.

names.name: ds-fill-y
names.note: A mark scaled to its share squashes its round end; --ds-share clips it. Use .ds-enter--fill.

names.name: .ds-enter--fill-x
names.note: The mark sets --ds-share instead of its own scaleX().

names.name: .ds-enter--fill-y
names.note: The mark sets --ds-share instead of its own scaleY().

names.name: enter(el, 'fill-x')
names.note: The 'fill-x' variant of DS.motion.enter() and enterAll(); the mark sets --ds-share.

names.name: enter(el, 'fill-y')
names.note: The 'fill-y' variant of DS.motion.enter() and enterAll(); the mark sets --ds-share.

names.name: ds-edge-fade
names.note: Internal and unused: the card table wrappers fade through the scroll-edge numbers and --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: --ds-table-fade-start
names.note: Internal and unused; the length of every fade is --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: --ds-table-fade-end
names.note: Internal and unused; the length of every fade is --ds-scroll-fade.

names.name: detach()
names.note: The detach method of the handle that DS.ripple.attach() returns; the pattern finds any detach() call.
